heading: Meet the Team
intro: A small but dedicated team, we at Kelly Marie Wellbeing are passionate about delivering quality wellbeing support for businesses and workforces.

people.name: Kelly Marie
people.bio: A psychotherapist with over a decade of clinical experience working with individuals, couples, young people and organisations. Kelly's practice is grounded in psychodynamic theory alongside integrative and trauma-informed approaches. She specialises in workplace therapy and wellbeing, and has worked with organisations including LADBible and Genuit Group.

faqs.question: Will I always see the same therapist?
faqs.answer: Yes. Continuity is central to how therapy works, and you will see the same person throughout. If that ever needs to change, it is discussed with you well in advance.

faqs.question: Is everyone here registered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Everyone working in this practice is a registered member of the BACP and works within its Ethical Framework, including regular clinical supervision.

faqs.question: Are you taking on new clients?
faqs.answer: Availability changes often. There may not be a space this month, but it is always worth asking — I would rather be honest with you about likely timescales than leave you waiting.

ctaText: I am always glad to hear from BACP-registered therapists whose approach might fit here, particularly those with experience of workplace or group work. Equally, if you are looking for support rather than a role, the door is open.
